title: Every Joomla quickstart pins Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.29 (extension.install streams the package to a file), with the published asset's bytes and sha256, in both catalogues
steps: S1: Read every Joomla entry with a cowork pin in apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json and packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/provision/quickstarts.json.
expect: S1: every Joomla pin is file pkg_claudecowork-0.24.29.zip, version 0.24.29, bytes 42593192, sha256 14080d2b…12050dee, url of release joomla-v0.24.29; the provision copy pins the same.
evidence: Before this PR every Joomla quickstart pinned 0.24.28, whose extension.install read the whole package into PHP memory: installing the 42.6 MB pkg_claudecowork through the API peaked at 127.9M on a Joomla 6 stand locked at 128M and was a memory fatal (HTML 500) at 96M
fence: Every contract of 0.24.28 is carried unchanged: pin-joomla-cowork.mjs refuses a release whose zip does not carry the recorded contract files byte for byte
